baseGameSpecifications.scope: Base-game published system requirements; excludes Reign and DLC

observedSnapshot.context: Already-running long-lived development/test campaign; read-only sampling. No battle, fresh-campaign comparison or peak benchmark was run.
observedSnapshot.limits: Private commit, working set, Linux used memory and process RSS are different views. Do not sum Linux per-process RSS with shared PostgreSQL pages or add host vmmem usage to the guest again. A rough combined burden is not an exact physical-RAM total or typical range.

planningRecommendations.status: The earlier 32 GB planning recommendation was withdrawn on 2026-11-06. A single development snapshot and mixed memory views cannot establish ordinary use or a hardware requirement. The user reports repeatedly running the game and Reign with substantially less RAM.
planningRecommendations.storage: Additional SSD space and several tens of GB of free update/backup headroom; no measured universal installed-size claim
planningRecommendations.remainingWork: Representative fresh/mature campaign and battle/load/save memory sampling on supported release artifacts
